title: Boss Battle: The Lunch Rush
story: Receipts are moving again. One worker cannot drain the lunchtime backlog.
objective: Bring checkout-worker to three ready replicas and keep checkout-api at one. Verify the rollout.
hints: A Deployment controls how many Pods should run.
List Deployments to compare desired and ready replicas.
Use kubectl scale deployment/checkout-worker --replicas=3, then kubectl get deployments to check readiness.
explanation: Scaling sets the desired count. The controller observes that change and starts Pods until the ready count catches up.
